response.justification: The candidate is an accomplished full-stack and systems engineer with a broad and impressive career, but his profile does not match the core requirements of this role: he lacks recent, hands-on C++ development on Windows, has no SQL Server/Oracle experience, and shows no exposure to fixed income, capital markets, or investment banking domains beyond a brief tangential fintech role at RIDE Capital (which used Node/TypeScript/GraphQL, not C++). His limited C++ exposure was over a decade ago at National Instruments and is not Windows-focused.
strengths: Strong overall software engineering craftsmanship and breadth (web, mobile, embedded, systems)
Some brief C and C++ experience (National Instruments, bachelor thesis)
Excellent communication skills, teaching/workshop experience, fluent English
concerns: No recent or substantial C++ experience, and no Windows-platform C++ development
No SQL Server or Oracle experience listed (only MongoDB/MySQL)
No fixed income, derivatives, or capital markets domain experience despite one fintech role

key_factors.factor: No fixed income/capital markets domain expertise
